content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Writes residential homeowners and condo coverage for coastal homes, a personal-lines niche unlike the target's specialty commercial lines."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Its specialty commercial property and casualty insurance business matches the target's, though its annuity arm is a different business."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Underwrites specialty property, casualty and professional lines for businesses via agents and brokers, closely matching the target's model."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"A brokerage earning commissions and fees without underwriting or bearing the insurance risk the target carries."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"An online health and Medicare enrollment marketplace earning carrier commissions, not underwriting risk."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells consumer insurance leads and referrals as an online marketing business, with no underwriting of risk."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Sells retail annuities and life insurance to individuals for retirement, a different customer and product base."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Underwrites commercial property and liability for small businesses and contractors through agents, though it also writes personal lines."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Mainly title insurance and mortgage guaranty for real estate transactions, with general commercial lines a smaller part."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Life insurance, mortgage lending and cemetery operations sold to individual families, unrelated to specialty commercial insurance."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Title insurance, escrow and real estate data for property transactions, a different business from commercial specialty underwriting."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"An insurance brokerage earning commissions and consulting fees, not an underwriter bearing the risk and collecting premiums."}]}
